name: Jitsi Meet
tagline: Video conferences on your own terms
description: Self-hosted video conferencing: unlimited participants, no accounts needed, screen sharing and recording. A private Zoom alternative.
compose:
services:
  jitsi-web:
    image: jitsi/web:stable-9779
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    environment:
      PUBLIC_URL: "https://${{cfg.domain}}"
      ENABLE_AUTH: "0"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
